name: isOutboundTLSEnforced
definition: True when the email service delivers outbound mail only over TLS: it requires TLS, so a message is never sent in clear text to a receiving server that offers none.
population: the outbound mail the email service sends for one account; one account-level setting, not a per-message count
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful read of the account's enforced TLS setting showing TLS is required for delivery; an error, 401/403 or empty read is Not evaluated.
citations: SendGrid API reference, Enforced TLS settings (twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/settings-enforced-tls): GET /v3/user/settings/enforced_tls returns require_tls, require_valid_cert and version

changeLog.change: Registered so the SendGrid email-security transformations can emit it. Meaning written from the public SendGrid API reference and one read of a real account (read-only); no replay-backed validation yet, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Account-level setting read from SendGrid, which is the first email-sending service registered under this meaning. Opportunistic TLS (sent when offered) is False here. Other sending services may register the same key if they carry the same meaning. Messaging Security is allowed too because the SendGrid integration is catalogued under communication (Messaging Security).
